dict.string: PhoneFM reads your heart rate, HRV, sleep, activity, ECG, and connected health-record data to compute a personalized cardiovascular risk trend. All inference runs on your device; no data leaves your iPhone.
PhoneFM does not write to your Health data.

PhoneFM reads diagnoses, medications, lab results, and procedures from your connected health records (Apple Health Records via your hospital) to contextualize your cardio risk trend. All processing is on-device.
